hypotheses.title: Consensus Cash Flow Yield Turnover Compression (Industry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 115, Candidate 2 achieved Sharpe 1.25 and passed Self-Correlation (< 0.70) in Industry Neutral. Extending the short-term delta smoothing from 3 to 5 days and increasing decay from 4 to 6 compresses turnover from 26.4% down to ~13%, mathematically elevating Fitness past the 1.50 threshold while maintaining zero options correlation.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha returns fail if consensus cash flow forecasts consistently lag actual statements.

hypotheses.title: Forecast Dividend Yield Convexity (Subindustry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: In Batch 115, Candidate 3 delivered Sharpe 1.37, Sub-universe Sharpe 1.05, and passed Self-Correlation (< 0.70). Extending delta smoothing to 5 days and Decay to 6 reduces turnover from 25.4% down to ~12%, scaling Fitness from 0.76 to >= 1.50 to clear all 8 platform gates for Alpha 3.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha fails in zero-interest-rate speculative growth regimes.

hypotheses.title: Forecast Dividend Yield Convexity (Industry Neutral, Decay 6)
hypotheses.economic_rationale: Industry-level neutralization broadens peer comparisons beyond narrow subindustries to capture broader sector-wide dividend yield disparities, retaining low turnover with Decay 6.
hypotheses.falsification_test: Alpha inverts when high-dividend sectors undergo structural underperformance.
